design_specs.hoplite: Greek foot soldier: large round aspis shield with simple angular chevron, spear, crested helmet. Shield roughly 35% of visual mass. Bone helmet and armour with ink outlines, blood red crest, bone linen skirt, greaves and strapped sandals. No cloak. Plain bone-and-ink spear and shield, no gold.
design_specs.anubis: Anubis: lean watchful jackal-headed man with two tall upright ears and long narrow muzzle. Ink-black head and bare human chest with bone graphic highlights. Bone linen kilt, broad bone/ink/blood collar with NO gold. Carries was-sceptre: straight staff, forked base, stylized animal-head top. Ears, muzzle and sceptre define silhouette.
design_specs.zeus: Zeus: broad shoulders, imperious expression, huge full bone-white beard, bone hair. Right hand carries large bold zigzag bone-white thunderbolt outlined in ink, never gold/yellow. Blood-red aegis cloak over one shoulder, bone draped tunic, bare lower legs with sandals. Beard and thunderbolt major silhouette masses. No gold crown or ornament.
design_specs.thor: Thor: stocky, powerful, lower and wider proportions than Zeus while same standing image height. Heavy bone-white beard, bone-and-ink winged helmet. Large blunt rectangular short-handled war hammer Mjolnir held forward. Blood-red cloak #8C2F20, bone-and-ink tunic, belt, bracers and heavy boots. Hammer, helmet wings and beard break silhouette. No gold.
design_specs.cronus: Cronus: colossal heavy hunched hooded old titan, gaunt face, deep-set eyes, heavy limbs. Huge curved sickle harpe about 35% visual mass, bone blade with ink outline. Ink and bone hooded robes with restrained blood-red lining, layered angular folds, massive feet. Menacing, aged, barely fits frame yet same 430px standing figure height as other characters, no scale increase. No gold.
